description: Ask for a public list page by URL or in words. A covered page returns its source and rows now. Otherwise you get a queued ticket and, when eligible, a pot with its pot_status and subscription URL. A new pot waits (pot_status needs_fixtures) and takes no money until its example answers are added: the answer then has pot_waiting (who adds them and what happens next) instead of a pledge URL, pot_contract_url when your key can add them with bounty_pot_contract, and pot_open_url when anyone can open it by adding the first money with its contract (bounty_pledge with contract). A pot needs up to 20 named fields (1 to 80 characters each) and no request for an opinion or judgment; otherwise the response is not_machine_checkable with post_bounty_url.

fields.description: Optional columns you need. Omit or send [] for a ticket only.

need.description: What source or rows you need, written in words.

note.description: Anything that helps a person judge it.

name: request_source
title: Request a source that is not listed
